remarks: This New England-style center hall colonial sits majestically atop a long private drive in idyllic back country Greenwich. The combination of outdoor spaces, set on 4 acres, make this home ideal for relaxation & entertaining...an in-ground pool, pool house, tennis court, and a versatile heated barn for creative pursuits. The interior features truly create an inviting atmosphere. Custom moldings, a wood-burning fireplace & beamed ceilings in the formal living room add character & elegance. The spacious dining room, with its vaulted ceiling & built-ins, can comfortably host large gatherings. In the chef's kitchen, the gas range & center island make cooking a pleasure, while the brick fireplace adds a unique charm that sets it apart from typical kitchens. The family room has walls of windows, allowing natural light to flood the space. All of these features & a flexible floor plan contribute to making this home so special. The main-level primary bedroom suite has an adjacent space to work or relax. Upstairs, there's a 2nd primary bedroom with a concept to add a full bath. There are 3 more bedrooms & 2 full baths on this level. Above the 2-car garage, a bedroom, den & bath create a very private suite for guests or extended family. Find more space & a wine cellar on the lower level. New exterior paint will bring this home back to its original splendor. More ways to add value exist here. Zoned for horses & beach rights. This wonderful property has all one could need to enjoy life!
